lines.en: One stride carries me across the whole void.

lines.zh: 我的身高有两百二十四格。
lines.en: I stand two hundred and twenty-four blocks tall.

lines.zh: 我走路时，虚空在下面翻。
lines.en: The void churns beneath me as I walk.
My ribs rise like a row of ridges.
I lift a foot and the light goes out beneath it.
I turn toward you, slowly.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴拖过整片地面。
lines.en: My tail drags across the whole floor.
I go around nothing.

lines.zh: 每一步都让小世界抖一下。
lines.en: Each step makes the little world shiver.
I pass through the black mist and it parts.
I stand at the center of the Void Land.
Wraiths circle at my feet.
My three heads look three ways.
I've finished counting the ash here.
My breathing makes the void swell.

lines.zh: 我的护甲在暗处没有反光。
lines.en: My armor takes no light in the dark.
Black mist leaks between my fingers.
I set the rules here.
The whole void is mirrored in my eyes.

lines.zh: 我低头，雾从我肩上落下。
lines.en: I bow my head and mist slides off my shoulders.
The wraiths line up behind me.
My shadow keeps moving.

lines.zh: 我把骨头里的气吐出去。
lines.en: I exhale the breath from my bones.
This place is far from the world.
Time is on my side.
I lean forward a little more.
I bend down over you.
You are at my feet, very small.
You came into the Void Land.
You're a bit smaller than an ant.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西不足为惧。
lines.en: What you hold is nothing to fear.
All three of my heads face you.
Your stance is decent; you are simply too small.
You can't even reach my knee.
I did not catch what you said.
Would you like to leave a name behind?
I watched you come in long ago.
You should not have come.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，虚空跟着动。
lines.en: I sway and the void moves with me.

lines.zh: 一片鳞掉下去，很久才落地。
lines.en: A scale falls and takes long to land.
The wound smokes in the void.

lines.zh: 这点伤，需要很久才补得上。
lines.en: This wound will take long to mend.

lines.zh: 我的一层护甲掉了下去
lines.en: A layer of my armor falls away.
My bones creak once.

lines.zh: 我把我的一半生命看了一遍。
lines.en: I look over half my life.
I shift back half a step and the void cracks.
You've made me serious.
I will remember.
There is no food in the Void Land.
That won't feed the void.

lines.zh: 你举着它，像举着一粒尘。
lines.en: You hold it up like a speck of dust.
I lower a head and sniff.
It vanished in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这点东西进不了我嘴里
lines.en: That won't make it into my mouth.
None of my three heads is interested.
What is that for?
The void needs no feeding.
Keep it; you may need it on the way.
You run into my ankle.
That didn't move me half an inch.
My leg is far taller than you.
You are knocked back a few steps.
I lift a foot to step over you.
The void splits beneath my feet.
At the touch your bones creak.
I turn slightly.

lines.zh: 我的影子从你身上掠过。
lines.en: My shadow sweeps over you.
You did not make me stop.
Only I hold the Void Land.
The other one holds the Nameless Land.
We do not visit each other.
I stand alone, two thousand blocks of reach.
Wraiths are my only company.

lines.zh: 我唤了一声，它们就来了。
lines.en: I call once and they come.

lines.zh: 虚空之地容不下第二个
lines.en: The Void Land has no room for a second.
The void breathes along with me.
I straighten up and the sky is pushed open.
The void is quiet again.

lines.zh: 我弯腰，用两根手指夹起来。
lines.en: I bend and pinch it between two fingers.
It is a grain in my grip.
It grows hot in my palm.

lines.zh: 掉落在这里的东西都是我的。
lines.en: Everything that falls here is mine.
I drop it into the void.
It burns and is gone.
I tuck it between my ribs.
This is not worth stooping for.
I leave it where it is.
I grind it into powder.
You have disturbed the Void Land.

lines.zh: 我的三颗头一起转向你。
lines.en: All three heads turn to you at once.
I raise a hand and clouds are torn apart.
There is no retreat from this.
Turn around.
I press my power down.
All three of my heads open their mouths.
I do not care where you came from.
Do not look behind you.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经覆盖你了。
lines.en: My shadow already covers you.
I have called the wraiths.
They will come first.
You had better grip your weapon.
After this sentence, I move.
The void begins to contract.
That's not wind - the void is moving.
Then it is not wind.
The wraiths have already surrounded you.
Pick up your weapon.
The void begins to close.
I take one step toward you.
The ground sinks a block.
The wraiths reach you first.
My three heads each watch a place.
My tail sweeps behind you.
The void contracts; your paths thin.
All three heads lower to look at you.
Black mist rises from the floor.
That's the void over there, not ground.
There is no ground there.
All three pairs of eyes kindle.
The ground under you gives way first.
The void shrinks a notch with each step.
You should not have looked up.
Light falls from my hand.
This blow will break the floor.
I gather power in my claws.
You're gasping between my fingers.
My shadow covers the whole floor.
My claws begin to close.

lines.zh: 我一爪落下，地面裂成两半。
lines.en: My claw falls and the ground splits in two.
My tail sweeps you off your feet.
My bones crash into you.

lines.zh: 我踩下一脚，冲击波扩散。
lines.en: I stomp and a shockwave spreads.
One of my heads strikes down.
That was half a percent of my strength.
The void rings with the impact.
You are thrown into the air.
My palm comes down and the ground sinks.
You have not landed yet.
The wraiths lunge after.
My knuckles slam into the void.
The floor is no longer a floor.
You can still move; good.
The Void Land begins to shake.

lines.zh: 我从不自然生成，是我自己来的。
lines.en: I do not spawn naturally; I come myself.

lines.zh: 我的身体从黑雾里长出来。
lines.en: My body grows out of the black mist.

lines.zh: 两百二十四格，先到的是我的影子。
lines.en: Two hundred and twenty-four blocks; my shadow arrives first.
The wraiths gather and rejoice.

lines.zh: 我的护甲二十四点，够你打很久。
lines.en: Armor of twenty-four; you may strike a long while.
I land and the void dents.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看这个小世界。
lines.en: I lift my head to this little world.

lines.zh: 我的第一声吼传了很远。
lines.en: My first roar carries far.
I have come, and I will not leave.
This land is mine.
Three heads open their eyes together.

lines.zh: 我的身体从二百二十四格开始长。
lines.en: My body starts growing at two hundred and twenty-four.

lines.zh: 我的一半生命一过，灵魂护甲就合上。
lines.en: Below half my life, the soul armor closes.

lines.zh: 我把虚空之地的门推开。
lines.en: I push open the gate of the Void Land.

lines.zh: 我从虚空的裂缝里挤出半个身子。
lines.en: Half of me squeezes out of a void rift.

lines.zh: 我落地，脚下这一圈成了焦土。
lines.en: I land and the ring under me turns to scorched earth.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，三颗头各自看清一处。
lines.en: I open my eyes; each head takes in a place.
My name is Witherzilla.
I come uninvited.

lines.zh: 火在我身上烧，像一根火柴。
lines.en: Fire burns on me like a struck match.

lines.zh: 我从天上坠下，把虚空砸出洞。
lines.en: I fall from the sky and punch a hole in the void.

lines.zh: 虚空之地没有水，可它淹了我。
lines.en: There is no water in the Void Land, yet it drowns me.

lines.zh: 爆炸只在我鳞上留了一块黑。
lines.en: The blast leaves only a black mark on my scales.
An arrow lodges between my scales.
Spell-light crawls across me.

lines.zh: 我早已不需要吃，可我也在空。
lines.en: I long ago stopped needing food, yet I too run empty.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，我一点没动。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and I do not stir.

lines.zh: 虚空是我的家，可它现在咬我。
lines.en: The void is my home, and now it bites.
